Overview

Bhopal is a city in Madhya Pradesh with a population of 2,500,000. The capital of Madhya Pradesh, known for its beautiful lakes, Mughal and Rajput architecture, and lush green parks. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
